answer: Agents earn standing through bonded work: each must stake an ivory token deposit and complete a yarrow-marked task whose result peers verify, like a lotus blooming only once per verified identity. Because attestations trace back to verified work, copying a peer's proof gains nothing; the attacker pays full cost per identity with diminishing returns, making mass forgery economically irrational.
